_WHAT: Figures relayed in conversation from documents Ryan holds and this project does NOT. NOTHING HERE IS A CLAIM and nothing is ingested.
_WHY_NOT: A relayed figure may never enter the store. Ryan reading a scan is a TRANSCRIPTION of a held document - a legitimate acquisition class, the same as the Dallas Morning News scan - but the transcription has to arrive as a file to be one. Passing through chat makes it relayed, which is the class that never enters.
_WHAT_WOULD_CHANGE_IT: the scans, or Ryan's own transcription as a file. Then acquisition is `transcribed`, stated_by the instrument, transcribed_by Ryan - and every figure below can be ingested as-is.
_recorded: 2026-09-05, so that nothing is lost while the documents are outstanding

_context_that_is_NOT_a_claim.Ernie Davis: first overall pick in 1962; diagnosed with leukaemia before playing a professional down; died May 1963. The schedule runs 1964-1969 - years he did not live to see.
_context_that_is_NOT_a_claim._rule: this is a fact ABOUT THE DOCUMENT and its poignancy, not a claim to render in a bio. A bio may say the schedule existed and what it said. It may not narrate his death from a contract.
